scope: Distinct official text tokenizer generations across GLM, Qwen, DeepSeek, Xiaomi MiMo, MiniMax; model weights and remote Python execution excluded. Representative checkpoint inventory is explicit, not a claim of every checkpoint ever published.

deduplication.method: Rust-normalized canonical JSON of model, normalizer, pre_tokenizer, decoder, post_processor, added_tokens. Native profiles hash verified assets plus declared audited wrapper settings.
deduplication.preserves: Different token IDs, added-token flags, special-token inventory, normalizer, pre-tokenizer, decoder or post-processor remain separate.
deduplication.ignores: JSON whitespace/object-key order and tokenizer padding/truncation. Chat templates recorded separately; chat-template-only changes do not create a plain-text tokenizer generation.
deduplication.structural_sha256_encoding: UTF-8 JSON ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), SHA-256. Native spec official_source path excluded from hash.
deduplication.ordinary_pipeline_sha256_note: Excludes added-token matching and post-processing; shared ordinary core is not sufficient to alias tokenizers.
deduplication.no_behavioral_equivalence_claim: Same structural hash establishes equality of the recorded native Rust pipeline/settings, not model quality or chat-template behavior.
